# Functional Pathways


## 1. Methods

Data was evaluated with fastqc and determined to have nextera transposase adapter contamination. Data was run through Nephele's QC pipeline for adapter trimming. Trimmed data was passed through WGSA2 pipeline in Nephele where it was decontaminated for human reads. Pathway abundances as CPM (TPM equivalent) were used in this analysis.

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}

library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(stringr)
library(phyloseq)
library(metagMisc)
library(vegan)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(knitr)
library(GUniFrac)
library(ggrepel)
library(MMUPHin)
library(ggprism)
library(ggbreak)
library(microbial)
library(pairwiseAdonis)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(scales)
library(kableExtra)
library(pixiedust)
```

### Import data

Created phyloseq object.

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

data<-read.csv("merged_functional_pwy.csv", row.names=1, header=TRUE)


taxa <- data[, c("kingdom","phylum","class","OTU")]
data[, c("kingdom","phylum","class","order","OTU","ATCCMSA2002control_P1","ATCCMSA2002control_P2","NegativeControl","NegativeControl_P2")] <- NULL



```

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
metadata<-read.csv("BSS_metadata update10FEB2025.csv", row.names=1, header=TRUE)
metadata<-as.data.frame(t(metadata))
metadata[, c("ATCCMSA2002control_P1","ATCCMSA2002control_P2","NegativeControl","NegativeControl_P2")] <- NULL
metadata<-as.data.frame(t(metadata))

metadata$Age<-as.numeric(metadata$Age)
metadata$Day.of.sample.relative.to.BSS.administration<-as.numeric(metadata$Day.of.sample.relative.to.BSS.administration)

metadata$Day<-as.numeric(metadata$Day)
metadata$Calculated.BMI<-as.numeric(metadata$Calculated.BMI)
metadata$Days_colonoscopy_bl<-as.numeric(metadata$Days_colonoscopy_bl)
metadata$Days_colonoscopy_day0<-as.numeric(metadata$Days_colonoscopy_day0)
metadata$Timepoint <- factor(metadata$Timepoint,
    levels = c('Baseline','Day 0','Day 2','Day 8','Day 14','Day 28'),ordered = TRUE)

otu<-otu_table(data, taxa_are_rows=TRUE)
meta<-sample_data(metadata)
tax<-tax_table(as.matrix(taxa))
phylo_raw<-phyloseq(otu, meta, tax)

phylo_raw_df<-phyloseq_to_df(phylo_raw, addtax=F)
rownames(phylo_raw_df)<-phylo_raw_df[,1]
phylo_raw_df<-dplyr::select(phylo_raw_df, -c("OTU"))
metadata<-data.frame(sample_data(phylo_raw))
phylo_raw_df<-as.data.frame(t(phylo_raw_df))
#pairwise.adonis2(phylo_raw_df~SequenceRun, data=metadata)

phylo_raw
```



### Filtering

Filtered pathways abundances (TPM \>3 and prevalence of10%).

```{r}

#critical_value <- 0.00001*sum(taxa_sums(phylo_adj))
#phylo <- filter_taxa(phylo_adj, function(x) sum(x) > critical_value, TRUE)
#phylo

phylo<-phyloseq_filter_prevalence(phylo_raw, abund.trh= 10, prev.trh=0.1, abund.type="total", threshold_condition ="OR")

phylo

phylo_df<-phyloseq_to_df(phylo, addtax=F)
rownames(phylo_df)<-phylo_df[,1]
phylo_df<-dplyr::select(phylo_df, -c("OTU"))
metadata<-data.frame(sample_data(phylo))

summary(sample_sums(phylo))

#phylo_df_log<-log(phylo_df+1)

```

## 2. Effectors and Interactions

Looked for effectors and interaction variables: age, race, sex, ethnicity, etc. using PERMANOVA.

### 2.1 SequenceRun

```{r}

result<-adonis2(phyloseq::distance(phylo, method="bray") ~ sample_data(phylo)$SequenceRun)

result<-result[1,c(3,5)]

result$Comparison<-"Sequence Run"
rownames(result)<-result$Comparison

kable(result[,c(1,2)], caption="Table X. PERMANOVA results for investigating differences in functional composition.", format="html", full_width = FALSE, table.attr= "style='width:60%;'") %>% kable_styling(position="left", bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover"))

```

<br><br>

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=6, fig.align = 'left', fig.cap="**Figure X. PCoA depicting relationships between samples based on functional composition.**"}

ord_filt_subject<- ordinate(phylo, "MDS", "bray")  
all_pcoa_subject1 <- plot_ordination(phylo, ord_filt_subject, type = "site", 
                                   color = "SequenceRun") + 
  geom_point(size = 4) + theme_bw()
all_pcoa_subject1

```

<br><br>

## 3. Functional pathway composition and diversity

Examined differences between time point (Baseline, Day 0, Day 2, Day 8, Day 14, Day 28) using permutational multivariate analysis of variance (PERMANOVA).

### 3.1 PERMANOVA

#### 3.1.1 Bray-Curtis

```{r}
phylo_df<-as.data.frame(t(phylo_df))
bray<-pairwise.adonis2(phylo_df~Timepoint+SequenceRun, data=metadata, method="bray")

results_df <- do.call(rbind, bray)
results_df <- results_df[grepl("Model", rownames(results_df)), ]
results_df$Comparison<-rownames(results_df)
results_df<- results_df %>% mutate(Comparison = gsub(".Model", "", Comparison))
rownames(results_df)<-results_df$Comparison

results_df<-results_df %>% mutate_at(1:5, as.numeric)
results_df[c(1:5)] <- lapply(results_df[c(1:5)], round, digits = 3)

results_df[,c(1,2,6)]<-NULL
results_df %>% kable(caption="<strong>Table X. Differences in functional pathway composition using Bray-Curtis Dissimilarity.<strong>", format="html", full_width = FALSE, table.attr= "style='width:80%;'") %>% kable_styling(position="left", bootstrap_options = c("striped"))%>%
   column_spec(4, color=ifelse(results_df[,3] < 0.05, "green","black"))


library(downloadthis)
results_df %>%
  download_this(
    output_name = "PERMANOVAresults-pathways-bray",
    output_extension = ".xlsx",
    button_label = "Download results in excel",
    button_type = "default",
    has_icon = TRUE,
    icon = "fa fa-save"
  )

```

<br><br>

```{r fig.cap="**Figure X. PCoA depicting relationships between samples based on eukaryotic species using Bray-Curtis Dissimilarity.**", fig.align='left'}

ord_filt_subject<- ordinate(phylo, "MDS", "bray")  
all_pcoa_subject1 <- plot_ordination(phylo, ord_filt_subject, type = "site", 
                                   color = "Timepoint") + 
  geom_point(size = 4) + theme_bw()+ scale_colour_brewer(type="qual", palette="Paired") +stat_ellipse(level=0.95)+
  annotate(geom="text", x=0.60, y=-0.6, label="Baseline v Day2 ; p = 0.005",size=3, fontface="bold")+
  annotate(geom="text", x=0.57, y=-0.72, label="Day0 v Day2 ; p = 0.012",size=3, fontface="bold")+
  annotate(geom="text", x=0.56, y=-0.84, label="Day2 v Day8 ; p = 0.03",size=3, fontface="bold")+
  annotate(geom="text", x=0.58, y=-0.96, label="Day2 v Day14 ; p = 0.014",size=3, fontface="bold")+
  annotate(geom="text", x=0.58, y=-1.08, label="Day2 v Day28 ; p = 0.009",size=3, fontface="bold")+ggtitle("Bray-Curtis Dissimilarity")
all_pcoa_subject1

#ggexport(all_pcoa_subject1, filename="PCoA_BSS_Timepoints_with_stats_function.pdf", width=6, height=4)

library(downloadthis)
all_pcoa_subject1 %>%
  download_this(
    output_name = "PCOA_bray",
    output_extension = ".pdf",
    button_label = "Download figure as .pdf",
    button_type = "default",
    has_icon = TRUE,
    icon = "fa-solid fa-image",
    ggsave_args = list(height=8, width=8)
  )

```

<br><br>

### 3.2 Effectors and Interactions

Looking for differences in with time point with consideration of confounding or effecting factors above using PERMANOVA. 

```{r}

library(ggtext)

time<-adonis2(phyloseq::distance(phylo, method="bray") ~ sample_data(phylo)$Timepoint, by="margin")

time<-time[1,c(3,4,5)]
time$Comparison<-"Timepoint"

con<-adonis2(phyloseq::distance(phylo, method="bray") ~ sample_data(phylo)$Timepoint+sample_data(phylo)$SequenceRun, by="margin")
int<-adonis2(phyloseq::distance(phylo, method="bray") ~ sample_data(phylo)$Timepoint*sample_data(phylo)$SequenceRun, by="terms")

con<-con[1,c(3,4,5)]
int<-int[3,c(3,4,5)]
con$Comparison<-"Effect"
int$Comparison<-"Interaction"
result<-rbind(time, con, int)

rownames(result)<-result$Comparison

kable(result[,c(1,2,3)], caption="Table X. Potential effect and interaction of time and sequence run.") %>% kable_styling(position="left") %>% scroll_box(width="500px")

```

## 4. Differential abundance

Used Maaslin2 to look for differentially abundant taxa between timepoints after BSS and day 0 using a linear model ("LM"). SubjectID and Sequence Run were incorporated as random effects.

```{r results=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, cache=TRUE}

DA_metadata<-read.csv("BSS_metadata update10FEB2025.csv", row.names=1, header=TRUE)
DA_metadata<-as.data.frame(t(DA_metadata))
DA_metadata[, c("ATCCMSA2002control_P1","ATCCMSA2002control_P2","NegativeControl","NegativeControl_P2")] <- NULL
DA_metadata<-as.data.frame(t(DA_metadata))

DA_metadata$Age<-as.numeric(DA_metadata$Age)
DA_metadata$Day.of.sample.relative.to.BSS.administration<-as.numeric(DA_metadata$Day.of.sample.relative.to.BSS.administration)

DA_metadata$Day<-as.numeric(DA_metadata$Day)
DA_metadata$Calculated.BMI<-as.numeric(DA_metadata$Calculated.BMI)
DA_metadata$Days_colonoscopy_bl<-as.numeric(DA_metadata$Days_colonoscopy_bl)
DA_metadata$Days_colonoscopy_day0<-as.numeric(DA_metadata$Days_colonoscopy_day0)


library(Maaslin2)

subject_all = Maaslin2(
  input_data = phylo_df,
  input_metadata = DA_metadata, 
  output = "Timepoint_pathways_LM_day0",
  fixed_effects = c('Timepoint'), normalization="NONE", reference=c("Timepoint,Day 0"), random_effect=c("SubjectID","SequenceRun"), analysis_method="LM", plot_scatter = FALSE)

LM<-subject_all$results

table<-as.data.frame(LM[,c("feature","value","coef","qval","N.not.zero")])

table_sub<- table %>% filter(qval < 0.05)
table_sub2<- table_sub %>% filter(coef< -1)
table_sub3<- table_sub %>% filter(coef > 1)
table_sub4_day0<-rbind(table_sub2, table_sub3)
#write.csv(table_sub4_day0, "DAA_functional_pathways.csv")
```

```{r}

table_sub4_day0$OTU<-table_sub4_day0$feature
table_sub4<-merge.data.frame(table_sub4_day0, taxa, by="OTU", all.x=TRUE, all.y=FALSE)
table_sub5<-table_sub4[,c(1,4,5,7,8)]
names(table_sub5)[1]<-"Pathway"
names(table_sub5)[4]<-"Class"
names(table_sub5)[5]<-"Subclass"


table_sub5$qval<-formatC(table_sub5$qval, format = "e", digits = 2)
table_sub5$coef<-round(table_sub5$coef, digits = 2)

table_sub5 <- table_sub5[order(table_sub5$qval, decreasing=FALSE),]

table_sub5[] <- lapply(table_sub5 , gsub, pattern = "_", replacement = " ")

dust(table_sub5) %>%
  kable(caption = "<strong>Table X. Differentially abundant functional pathways at day 2 compared to day 0.<strong>") %>% column_spec(column=3, width_min="5em", include_thead = T)  %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped")) %>% 
  scroll_box(width = "800px", height="650px", fixed_thead=T)


library(downloadthis)
table_sub5 %>%
  download_this(
    output_name = "Differentally abundant functional pathways",
    output_extension = ".xlsx",
    button_label = "Download results in excel",
    button_type = "default",
    has_icon = TRUE,
    icon = "fa fa-save"
  )

```

### 4.1 Functional barchart

```{r message=FALSE}

phyla<-data.frame(table(table_sub4$phylum))
phyla <- data.frame(phyla[order(phyla$Freq, decreasing=TRUE), ])

top<-phyla %>% top_n(8) %>% 
  pull(Var1)

# Add a new column for coloring

phyla <- phyla %>%
  mutate(Color = ifelse(Var1 %in% top, as.character(Var1), "Other"))
phyla$phylum<-phyla$Var1

phyla$Color[3]<-"Other"
phyla$Color[5]<-"Other"
phyla$Color[11]<-"Drug_resistance_antimicrobial"
phyla$Color[14]<-"Metabolism_of_other_amino_acids"
phyla$Color[17]<-"Xenobiotics_biodegradation_and_metabolism" 


table_tax_color<-merge.data.frame(table_sub4, phyla, by="phylum", all.x=TRUE, all.y=TRUE)



table_tax_color$Color<- factor(table_tax_color$Color,
    levels = c('Amino_acid_metabolism','Metabolism_of_other_amino_acids','Carbohydrate_metabolism','Metabolism_of_cofactors_and_vitamins','Lipid_metabolism','Membrane_transport','Drug_resistance_antimicrobial','Infectious_disease_bacterial','Replication_and_repair','Xenobiotics_biodegradation_and_metabolism','Other'), ordered = TRUE)


table_tax_color$OTU <- factor(table_tax_color$OTU, levels = table_tax_color$OTU[order(table_tax_color$phylum, decreasing=TRUE)])

library(RColorBrewer); library(scales)

nb.cols<-11
mycolors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "Set3"))(nb.cols)


table_tax_color<- table_tax_color %>% mutate(updated_text = gsub("__", " ", OTU))

table_tax_color<- table_tax_color %>% mutate(updated_text = gsub("_", " ", OTU))

table_tax_color$updated_text<- factor(table_tax_color$updated_text, levels = table_tax_color$updated_text[order(table_tax_color$Color, decreasing=TRUE)])

table_tax_color<- table_tax_color %>% mutate(Color_updated = gsub("_", " ", Color))


stacked_species<-ggplot(table_tax_color, aes(x = updated_text, y = coef, fill=Color_updated)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",show.legend = TRUE) + xlab("Effect size") +scale_fill_manual(values=mycolors)+theme_classic()+geom_col(color="black")+theme(legend.position="right", legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"), legend.text=element_text(size=8), axis.text.x=element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size=10), axis.text.y=element_text(size=12), plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0))+labs(fill="Pathway")+ylab(NULL)+guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 11))+scale_x_discrete(limits = rev(levels(table_tax_color$updated_text)))


table_tax_color$qval_adj<--log10(table_tax_color$qval)

bubble_species<-ggplot(table_tax_color, aes(x=updated_text, y=value, size = qval_adj)) + geom_point(alpha=1, aes(color=Color_updated))+scale_size(range=c(2,8), "-log10(pvalue)")+scale_color_manual(values=mycolors)+theme_void()+guides(color="none", fill="none")+scale_x_discrete(limits = rev(levels(table_tax_color$updated_text)))+theme(legend.position="top", plot.margin = margin(25,195,25,20), legend.text=element_text(size=8))
